result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: one major layout truncation and one minor clipping issue.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section ('Trattoria Piccol...') is visually cut off — both the image and the restaurant name are truncated at the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal scroll container provides a visible affordance (e.g., partial card peek) that is intentional and consistent, or adjust padding/margins so the card name is not abruptly clipped mid-word.

issues.description: The last category filter pill in the horizontal category row is partially clipped on the right side, showing only a sliver of what appears to be another option beyond 'Healthy'.
issues.suggestion: This may be intentional to hint at horizontal scrollability, but adding a subtle fade or scroll indicator would better communicate the affordance to users.
